name: dotgrid.io — source-derived design tokens
scope: Current single-pattern checkout. No layer-list implementation is present here. Documentation assets only; tokens are not imported into the running app.
format: Project JSON manifest; not a claimed DTCG/Figma interchange format. CSS scalar values plus structured spring values.
assumptions: Pixel equivalents assume a 16px root font size.
Tailwind dependency values verified from the exact 4.3.3 tarball pinned in package-lock.json.
Observed means found in current source, not verified in a running browser.
User-generated pattern and preset colors are content, not fixed interface tokens.
